entities.name: ESM information transfer flag
entities.description: An information element included by the UE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message during attach procedure to indicate the need for security protected transfer of protocol configuration options or to provide an access point name.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: A message sent by the UE during the attach procedure to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: The procedure during which the UE sends the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: UE has protocol configuration options that need to be transferred security protected
entities.description: Condition where the UE has protocol configuration options requiring security protected transfer.

entities.name: UE wishes to provide an access point name
entities.description: Condition where the UE wishes to provide an access point name for the PDN connection.

relations.description: The PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains the ESM information transfer flag IE.
The attach procedure includes sending the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
The ESM information transfer flag IE is included if the UE has protocol configuration options that need to be transferred security protected.
The ESM information transfer flag IE is included if the UE wishes to provide an access point name.
